title: A blind prisoner is told he is king again | Folio 3 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
Think about that moment. A blind man, who has spent about ten years as a prisoner, is told by a crowd of soldiers that he is Sultan again. It is said that he did not want it. Some of the accounts suggest that he had to be pressed, even threatened, before he agreed. Whether that was true reluctance, or simply wisdom, we cannot know. A blind king at the head of a mutinous army was not a king for long in that world, and he may have known it. But he accepted. And because he could not see to govern, the real power went to his son Ahmad, a young man with his own anger and his own ambitions.

The full story: Folio 3: The Blind King Who Ruled Twice — on our channel and on every podcast app.
